16.2.3 2D Texture Volume Rendering - OpenGL
1. Generate the three sets of 2D textures from the volume data. Each set of 2D textures is oriented perpendicular to one of volume's major axes. This processing is done once for a particular data volume. 2. Choose the number of slices, based on the criteria in Section 16.2.5.
